meta.name: Grade POPIA website compliance using homepage and privacy policy HTML

parameters.content:
## POPIA Website Audit Workflow

### How it works

This workflow manually runs a POPIA-focused website audit for a configured website URL. It fetches the homepage, analyzes the HTML to locate or derive a privacy-policy page URL, then fetches that page and grades the site’s compliance based on custom code logic.

### Setup steps

- Configure the `website_url` value in the Audit Input node for the site to be audited.
- Ensure the HTTP Request nodes can access the target website and that any required network/proxy settings are configured in n8n.
- Review the custom code in the Analyze Homepage and Grade Compliance nodes to confirm the POPIA checks and scoring rules match your audit criteria.

### Customization

You can adjust the input URL, expand the homepage parsing logic to detect more policy-link patterns, and modify the grading code to reflect different POPIA compliance requirements or scoring thresholds.

## Start and input setup

Manually starts the audit and sets the website URL that the rest of the workflow will analyze.

## Homepage and policy fetch

Fetches the homepage HTML, runs custom analysis to find the relevant privacy policy URL, and retrieves that policy page for review.

## Compliance grading

Applies the final custom grading logic to the fetched privacy policy content and produces the POPIA compliance result.

nodeGroups.name: Ingest
nodeGroups.description: Take the website URL to audit and fetch the target website HTML.

nodeGroups.name: Analyze
nodeGroups.description: Detect trackers, consent and the privacy policy link, try common policy paths as a fallback, fetch the policy page, and grade site + policy compl
